input.quote: 11.6 Insurance. Each Party shall obtain and carry in full force and effect the minimum insurance requirements set forth herein. Such insurance (a) shall be primary insurance with respect to each Party's own participation under this Agreement, (b) shall be issued by a recognized insurer rated by A.M. Best "A-VII" (or its equivalent) or better, or an insurer pre- approved in writing by the other Party, and (c) shall list the other Party as an additional insured under the General Liability Policy.
input.rationale: Section 11.6 contains a usable insurance clause binding each Party (including Harpoon): general liability insurance with per-occurrence and aggregate limits including clinical trial coverage (11.6.1(c)), workers' compensation at statutory limits and employer's liability where it has U.S. employees (11.6.1(a)-(b)), certificates of insurance on request plus claims-made tail coverage (11.6.2), and A.M. Best-rated insurers with AbbVie named as additional insured. That matches the structure of the preferred position on the material terms for this development/option collaboration. No professional (E&O) or cyber/privacy layer is specified, but Harpoon is a co-development partner that does not host or process Customer Data or work on our premises, so those limits are not engaged; the specific dollar limits are redacted ([***]) and should be confirmed commercially. Section 11.6.3 preserves AbbVie's right to self-insure, which benefits us. No redline warranted.
